notes.title: Update 1.02a
notes.content: Greetings, ascended ones! We have prepared a small update that fixes bugs, adjusts balance, and introduces several minor quality-of-life improvements. Enjoy your game!

notes.title: Early Access is Started!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357694/a75dcb0f63f193801404eddc6cbad3401354430c.png

Hey gamers! Ready for a wild journey into the heart of chaos?

We just launched a new game that literally blows your mind! Imagine this: you're defending the Soulforge—a celestial structure that turns the souls of demonic filth into powerful weapons. Sounds crazy? Trust me, that's just the tip of the iceberg!

Every time you think you've uncovered all its secrets, the game changes. The world transforms after each defeat, so boredom isn't an option. And the coolest part—you can assemble a team of up to 4 people! Invite friends, family, or even new online buddies. Surviving together isn't just easier; it's way more fun!

The choice is yours: become an angelic savior or a ruthless warrior. Collect powerful artifacts, gain new abilities and skills. In this world, every step could be your last, so use everything at your disposal.

How to start this epic adventure:

- Download the game on Steam right now!
- Join our Discord server where we coordinate co-op games and share strategies.
- Under the threat of eternal darkness and painful death, it's time to challenge yourself. Are you ready to accept the challenge?

Join us, and let's stand against chaos together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357694/e60e43d20f47e42009f31373efc832d40d7fc74e.jpg

If you have a thirst for adventure and nerves of steel, this game is definitely for you. See you in-game!

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 is now available for content creators
notes.content:
Hello there! We have some exciting news for you in this update. We've made several significant changes to make your battle against demonic horrors even more captivating. Here's what you can expect:

https://i.imgur.com/9ITHjIQ.gif
New Hero - Lila
We introduce a new hero - Lila. Her unique skills and abilities will allow you and your friends to be more effective in fighting the invasion. Include Lila in your team and feel the power of celestial protection.

Improved Invasion Indication
Now you'll have a clearer view of the approaching invasion. Don't miss a moment - every second is precious, and this indication will help you prepare for battle in advance.

Redesigned Loading Screen
We've revamped the loading screen to provide you with more detailed information about the game's basics. Even newcomers will find it easy to understand what they need to do.

Enhanced Tips
We've made in-game tips more colorful and noticeable. Now you won't miss important moments and can quickly respond to threats.

Russian Localization
Hellwatch is now available in Russian! We've also laid the groundwork for localization in other languages, giving players from around the world the opportunity to redeem their sins.

Stronger Enemies
Our demonic enemies haven't been idle. We've introduced enhanced versions of adversaries, making battles more intense and challenging.

Bug Fixes
We've also addressed a significant number of bugs because your gaming experience and comfort are our top priorities.

Are you ready for this battle? Success depends on your skill and teamwork. Rise above the darkness, protect the Forge of Souls, and prove that you can endure as long as possible.

https://i.imgur.com/kOS5WFA.jpg

notes.title: Hellwatch Patch note Version 0.1.5.620
Hellwatch Patch note - Version 0.1.4.390
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44357694/bdb7d398d94daea66922b6a5889257d7d1ecd022.png
For over 180 days and sleepless nights, we've been working on the Hellwatch project. Take a look at the results we achieved in two weeks:


 Finalized the customization of affixes: in-game debuffs that are applied to the player after death.
 The new character "Leela", which we will tell you about very soon, has a new animation.
 The En page on Steam has been finalized and we are starting to work on the Russian version.
 The matchmaking system has been finalized, now it's easier for players to find each other in the queue.
 Updated character portraits, now they have a more attractive visual style.
 Improved animation in the game menu.
 Added a new map generator that easily gives the impression of an open world.
 Rendered several new locations and added additional content to them to create a more immersive gameplay experience.
